summary.text: Dan Innis is a Republican state senator from Bradford, New Hampshire, who has represented District 7 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the State Senate for District 24 from 2016 to 2018, and his career experience includes work as a university professor and dean.

paragraphs.text: Innis was born in Columbus, Ohio, and lives in Bradford, New Hampshire. He earned a B.B.A. from Ohio University in 1985, an M.B.A. from Miami University (Ohio) in 1986, and a Ph.D. in marketing from Ohio State University in 1991.

His career experience includes co-founding The Hotel Portsmouth and the Ale House Inn, working as a professor of marketing and hospitality management at the University of New Hampshire, and serving as dean of the University of Maine College of Business, Public Policy, and Health and as dean of the University of New Hampshire Whittemore School of Business and Economics.
Innis represented District 24 in the State Senate from 2016 to 2018 and assumed office representing District 7 on December 7, 2022.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Commerce Committee and is vice chair of the Education Finance and Senate Finance committees.
